subject: Condominium Conversion Ordinance
overview: The committee reviewed a preliminary draft of a condominium conversion ordinance aimed at preserving rental housing stock and protecting tenants from displacement. The paper was kept in committee to allow for further consultation with city staff.

items.title: Condominium Conversion Ordinance
items.summary: Chair Kit Collins presented a draft ordinance that proposes tenant relocation payments, notification requirements, and the creation of a condominium and cooperative review board. The motion to keep the paper in committee passed, pending a forthcoming decision-points memo and future discussions with planning and building officials.
